# Compass Forge AI

> AI consulting and agent development by Yair Berger. Compass Forge AI helps individuals, SMBs, and startups put AI to work through 1:1 consulting sessions, workshops, advisory, and custom AI agent builds.

## About

Yair Berger is a Global Digital Marketing & AI Engineering Manager who builds AI systems for a living and consults independently under the name Compass Forge AI. He works with Claude, OpenAI, n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, and Salesforce, building agentic systems, automation pipelines, and AI content systems.

## Services

- 1:1 Sessions, focused consulting tailored to a specific business or problem
- Workshops and Masterclasses, from beginner AI introductions to hands-on team training
- Advisory, ongoing support through AI implementation
- Custom AI agent development, agentic systems, automation pipelines, and AI content systems

## Real projects built

- SDR Command Center, a full outbound sales operations system, from lead enrichment through CRM handoff
- ARIA, a fully local agentic AI assistant with no cloud dependency
- Morning Brief Agent, an automated daily briefing delivered by phone
- Weekly AI Digest, an automated weekly news synthesis delivered by email
- Used Car Evaluator, an AI decision engine for vehicle purchasing
- Smart QR Code Generator, a marketing tool with built-in campaign tracking
